svg.title: How DreamZero turns a video model into a policy
svg.desc: Past camera frames, a language instruction, and the robot state are encoded and fed to a pretrained video diffusion model, Wan 2.1 14B. The model jointly denoises future video frames and an action chunk with flow matching. The robot executes the action chunk, and the real camera frames it records replace the predicted frames in the model's KV cache before the next chunk is generated.
